senses.gloss: f. (פקק; cmp. פְּקַעַת) lump, ball, swelling, esp.

units: <cite ref="Mishnah Chullin 10:4">Ḥull. X, 4</cite> (<cite ref="Chullin 134b:14">134ᵇ</cite>) <he>פ׳ של גרגרת</he> thyroid cartilage; <cite ref="Mishnah Negaim 10:9">Neg. X, 9</cite>.
<cite ref="Mishnah Negaim 10:10">Ib. 10</cite> <he>פ׳ של צואר</he> the protruding cartilage of the neck; <cite ref="Tosefta Negaim 4:12">Tosef. ib. IV, 12</cite> <he>פ׳ של פירקא</he>.
<cite ref="Mishnah Bekhorot 7:6">Bekh. VII, 6</cite> (<cite ref="Bekhorot 45a:1">45ᵃ</cite>) <he>פ׳ יוצאה מגודלו</he> (not <he>יצא</he>) one that has a lump on his thumb; a. fr.

senses.gloss: a protuberance on the blossom end of fruits, v. פִּיטְמָא II.
units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Sukkah 3:6:3">Y. Succ. III, 53ᵈ</cite> <cite ref="Q00796"><he>פיקא</he></cite>.

senses.gloss: spinner’s coil. Ohol. VII, 4 עד שיעגילו ראש כפ׳ until the embryos (on leaving the vagina) form a round head like a coil; expl.
units: <cite ref="Bekhorot 22a:5">Bekh. 22ᵃ</cite> <he>כפ׳ של צמר</he> like a coil of wool.

<cite ref="Bekhorot 22a:5">Ib.</cite>; <cite ref="Tosefta Ohalot 8:8">Tosef. Ohol. VIII, 8</cite> <he>פ׳ של שתי</he> the coil containing the warp; <he>פ׳ של ערב</he> containing the woof. Bekh. l. c. <he>נראית פ׳ מתוך פ׳</he> it has the appearance of a coil coming forth out of a coil, v. <cite ref="I00657"><he>טְפִיפִית</he></cite>.

<cite ref="Bekhorot 45a:4">Bekh. 45ᵃ</cite> <he>בעל הפיקין</he> (not <he>הקיפין</he>) one afflicted with lumps; (Ar. Var. <he>הפיקס</he>; Ar. s. v. <cite ref="K00961"><he>כסת</he></cite>: <he>הפִּיקָן</he>; Mish. ib. VII, 6 <he>בעל פיקה</he>; Talm. ed. 45ᵃ <he>הפיקום</he>, Rashi: <he>הפיקין</he>). Ib. 22ᵃ <he>שלש פ׳ שמעתי וכ׳</he> I learned of three sizes of coils, one of the warp, one of the woof, and one large coil, that of the sack-weavers; <cite ref="Tosefta Keilim Metsia 7:1">Tosef. Kel. B. Mets. VII, 1</cite>, v. <cite ref="O01466"><he>סַקָּי</he> I</cite>.
<cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 14:3">Lev. R. s. 14</cite> <he>פ׳ פ׳</he> coils upon coils (in the abdomen).
<cite ref="Tosefta Ohalot 13:5">Tosef. Ohol. XIII, 5</cite>, v. <cite ref="L00118"><he>לָבַשׁ</he></cite>; a. e.
